texts.arguments: 4. Learned senior counsel appearing for the appellant takes several objections to the impugned judgment of the Appellate Tribunal. 5. First, it is argued that the entire premise of the order of the Adjudicating Authority, which was affirmed by the Tribunal, was a purported report of an analyst. However, the Adjudicating Authority did not attribute any reasons or even arrived at a specific finding as to misbranding, nor discussed the report of the analyst, prior to accepting the same in a perfunctory manner. 7. Learned senior counsel next argues that the statutory guidelines as to awarding penalty were not adhered to or discussed while fixing the quantum of the penalty against the appellant for the alleged misbranding of the appellant's product. 8.
